verdict.rationale: AiPrise claims live registry checks of company identity, registration status and ownership across 200+ countries. It offers a hosted business-verification flow and re-screens UBOs and directors, which covers registry lookups and some UBO handling. Nothing shows a documented KYB flow that hands identified owners into KYC verification, and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: a documented KYB-to-KYC chaining of UBOs/owners, explicit UBO identification/extraction details, in-depth KYB flow documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners

citations.quote: Confirm identity, registration status, ownership, and official company records across 200+ countries from live registry data.
Ongoing re-screening of business, UBOs, and directors against sanctions, PEP, watchlists, and adverse media.
Embed user or business verification directly in your web applications with a fully hosted, customizable flow
